prompt.description: What to make, for text to 3D. With images, leave it empty unless the images need explaining.
examples: a carved wooden owl perched on a branch
prompt.title: Prompt

images.description: One to five images of one object. The first image sets the materials.
images.title: Images

tier.description: Quality tier. Extreme-High costs 0.5 credits more and adds a mesh of up to 10M faces.
tier.title: Tier

mesh_mode.description: Raw triangles, or a quad mesh.
mesh_mode.title: Mesh Mode

quality_override.description: Exact face count, instead of quality. Above 1M needs the High or Extreme-High tier; Quad takes at most 200K.
quality_override.title: Quality Override

material.description: PBR maps, baked shading, both, hybrid, or no material.
material.title: Material

texture_mode.description: Texture quality. Empty: follows the tier. extreme-high gives 6K textures and costs 2 credits more.
texture_mode.title: Texture Mode

high_pack.description: The HighPack add-on: 4K textures, 8K with uhd_texture.
high_pack.title: High Pack

texture_delight.description: Remove lighting baked into the images from the texture.
texture_delight.title: Texture Delight

geometry_instruct_mode.description: faithful follows the images more literally (experimental).
geometry_instruct_mode.title: Geometry Instruct Mode

is_symmetric.description: Symmetry of the object, if known.
is_symmetric.title: Is Symmetric

t_a_pose.description: Put a human-like subject in a T or A pose.
t_a_pose.title: T A Pose

use_original_alpha.description: Use the images' own transparency as the mask.
use_original_alpha.title: Use Original Alpha
